subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:
The instructions have been misunderstood by many candidates.

options.text: Many candidates have misunderstood the instructions.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "The instructions have been misunderstood by many candidates."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "many candidates" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "have been misunderstood" to its active form "have misunderstood.&qu
